gitCommit.subject: fix: publish monocart report to GitHub Pages via Actions workflow
gitCommit.body:
fix: publish monocart report to GitHub Pages via Actions workflow

The previous setup only published from local cron (publish-report.sh),
leaving the gh-pages branch empty when Actions ran. Now the workflow
pushes monocart-report/ to gh-pages after every run (pass or fail).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
